SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${metrics_interval_s} SECOND) AS time,
  (max(value) - min(value)) / ${metrics_interval_s} as value

  ${database}.${perf_table}

  run_id = if('${run_id}' = '', (SELECT run_id FROM ${database}.${run_table} ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1), '${run_id}')

panels.description: Shows the latency per query, with target percentiles also present in the chart. Starts with the target p90 and actual p90, then target p50 and actual p50.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  concat(attributes['query_index'], ': ', attributes['query_name']) as query_name,
  any(toUInt64OrZero(attributes['perf.p90'])) as "target p90",
  quantile(0.90)(value) as p90,
  any(toUInt64OrZero(attributes['perf.p50'])) as "target p50",
  quantile(0.5)(value) as p50
FROM
  ${database}.${perf_table}
WHERE
  run_id = if('${run_id}' = '', (SELECT run_id FROM ${database}.${run_table} ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1), '${run_id}')
  AND metric_name = 'query_latency_micros'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY query_name
ORDER BY any(toUInt64OrZero(attributes['query_index'])) ASC

panels.description: Counts the number of queries that ran within a given time range. Grouped by minute.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(toUInt64(floor(toFloat64(attributes['time_range_seconds']) / 60))) AS minutes,
  count() AS query_count
FROM ${database}.${perf_table}
WHERE
  run_id = if('${run_id}' = '', (SELECT run_id FROM ${database}.${run_table} ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1), '${run_id}')
  AND metric_name = 'query_latency_micros'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY minutes
ORDER BY toUInt64(minutes) ASC
